components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Blue fill for the decisive action in a workflow.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #38a3f8); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--blue, #38a3f8); color: #04111e; font: 650 12px/1 'Figtree Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); background: var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet bordered control for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(154, 176, 209, 0.15)); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(16, 27, 46, 0.68); color: var(--text, #f0f0f6); font: 650 12px/1 'Figtree Variable', sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--rule-strong, rgba(56, 163, 248, 0.52)); color: var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Inset navy field for feedback and confirmation values.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--text, #f0f0f6); font: 620 13px/1.4 'Figtree Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(154, 176, 209, 0.15)); border-radius: 4px; background: #080e1d; color: var(--text, #f0f0f6); font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Muted route link with a thin blue active indicator.
components.html: ChallengesAnalytics
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; height: 44px; } .ds-nav a { display: grid; place-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--text-muted, #71809b); font: 620 14px/1 'Figtree Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.ds-active { color: var(--text, #f0f0f6); } .ds-nav a.ds-active { border-color: var(--blue, #38a3f8); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Difficulty Badge
components.description: Outlined metadata badge whose label reinforces its semantic color.
components.css: .ds-difficulty { display: inline-flex; width: max-content; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--amber, #f0b34d); font: 650 11px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; }

components.name: Editorial Challenge Row
components.description: Rule-divided recommendation row with title-first hierarchy.
components.html:
#33

components.css: .ds-challenge-row { min-height: 76px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 54px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(154, 176, 209, 0.15)); color: var(--text, #f0f0f6); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-challenge-id { align-self: start; padding-top: 3px; color: var(--blue, #38a3f8); font: 650 13px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-challenge-row h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.012em; } .ds-challenge-row p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted, #71809b); font-size: 12px; } .ds-challenge-row button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #38a3f8); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--blue, #38a3f8); color: #04111e; font: 650 12px/1 'Figtree Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-challenge-row button:hover { background: var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); border-color: var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); } .ds-challenge-row button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Activity Cell
components.description: Square, keyboard-focusable heatmap cell with touch adaptation.
components.css: .ds-heat { --ds-cell: 11px; width: var(--ds-cell); height: var(--ds-cell); padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--heat-3, #1b9a66); transition: transform 160ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-heat:hover { transform: scale(1.22); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--canvas, #080a19); } .ds-heat:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #71c4ff); outline-offset: 2px; transform: scale(1.16); } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-heat { --ds-cell: 24px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-heat { transition-property: background-color, border-color, color, opacity; } .ds-heat:hover, .ds-heat:focus-visible { transform: none; } }

components.name: Owned Timer
components.description: Green operational state for the single recommendation that owns the timer.
components.css: .ds-timer { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(72, 213, 151, 0.38); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--green, #48d597); font: 650 13px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-timer i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; box-shadow: 0 0 12px currentColor; }

narrative.overview:
Retain DSA is a precise daily tool: technical without costume, editorial without spectacle, and calm enough for honest reflection. Practice history leads the first view, curriculum progress provides context, and the recommendation queue presents clear next actions without turning the page into a scoreboard.

The identity comes from deep ink surfaces, broad display type, compact operational metadata, thin cool rules, and small state signals. Decorative effects stay local and quiet so real practice data remains the strongest visual material.
keyCharacteristics: green recorded activity and timer states

rules.name: The Signal Separation Rule
rules.body: Blue means interaction or progress, green means activity or timer state, amber means attention, and red means danger or hard difficulty. Never rely on color alone to communicate state.

rules.name: The Sparse Mono Rule
rules.body: Use monospaced type for IDs, timers, dates, counts, and technical status; keep narrative and action copy in Figtree.

rules.name: The Protected Elevation Rule
rules.body: Reserve strong shadow and backdrop blur for modal focus; ordinary rows and sections remain flat.

dos: Do make real activity and the next practice decision the dominant content.
Do use rules, alignment, and whitespace to organize editorial rows.
Do preserve clear keyboard focus, semantic calendar roles, roving focus, and touch-friendly calendar targets.
Do keep loading, error, empty, shortage, active, and paused states visually and verbally distinct.
donts: Don't turn the page into a uniform grid of equally weighted cards.
Don't use monospaced type, glow, gradients, or rounded containers as generic developer decoration.
Don't let progress, activity, timer, difficulty, and destructive signals share ambiguous color meaning.
Don't use continuous decorative motion; keep transitions short, functional, and reduced-motion aware.
